history.summary: A freehold 1BR (2013) in D12 Balestier/Toa Payoh fringe asking $1,935 PSF — ~7% below the $2,072 median, with a respectable 4.36%/yr URA rate on 39 transactions. Decent value and city-fringe location, but a low 941 Elo (poor arena record) and 860m MRT walk keep it at Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,935 vs $2,071.5 median = -7%, and 4.36%/yr appreciation on a usable 39-txn series is the better growth signal among the 1BRs here. Freehold helps. But the 106-195 arena record / 941 Elo is the weakest in the batch — peers consistently beat it — and 860m (10 min) to the future TE10 Mount Pleasant is a soft walk. Balestier is a mature, somewhat tired pocket. Fair value, unexciting; Neutral.
